message: 魔の手
With less than a month left until the Holy Night Festival.

name: Synn
message: 「It's about that time of year. I've got to go help out at the shopping district!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sorry, pal. I got no clue what kinda timing you're talkin' about.」

name: Synn
message: 「Before Christmas hits, they fix up the streetlights and illuminations.」
The electric lights in Shiokumi Shopping District aren't maintained by the city, but are installed and lit by volunteers from Ryuusei Town, starting with the shopkeepers.
Naturally, the bulbs burn out at random intervals. However, since it's far more dangerous than changing household bulbs, they hire a specialist contractor to replace them.
Still, calling a contractor every single time costs way too much. So once a year, right around now just before December, they replace all the burned-out bulbs with brand-new ones.

name: Synn
message: 「And I'm on carrying duty. They always take such good care of me, so doing this much is only right.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmm... hmmm? Twist it like this...」

name: Sally
message: 「Yahoo! A perfect fit♪」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Signboard, light, new one.」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa-oa-oa, next is over there! Once we swap out that light, we're all done!」
Inside the shopping district, Sally and Eauderourke had already divided up the work, removed the old bulbs, and finished replacing almost all of them.
Come to think of it, they're way better suited for this than I am.
Sally can fly freely through the air, making her a natural fit for the streetlights. Eauderourke is tall and strong, so he's handling the signboards.

name: Sally
message: 「All finished! Now we get to eat Odachin's extra-large beef bowls, hee-hee-hee!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Me, beef bowl, large.」

name: Sally
message: 「A-wa-wa-wah, I can't believe Boss is fine with something so small!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Beef bowl, large. Miso soup, pickles. And one order of egg!」

name: Sally
message: 「So that's a thing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, good work you two. Looks like I'm out of a job starting this year.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hiya, Prez! My hands got all dirty. Wipe, wipe, wipe.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You flat-chested brat! Don't go wipin' your hands on my body!!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Paqy, me, wipe-wipe too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「D-Don't come near me!!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Wipe-wipe.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aaaahhhhh~」

name: Sally
message: 「Hyooeeeh, Paqy's getting totally mobbed!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Muhaa... Th-This feels great~」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you getting so entranced for?」
Sally, Eauderourke, the demons, and the Demon Generals are all helping out everyone in Ryuusei Town.
I'm happy about it, but with fewer chores left for me to help with, I couldn't help feeling a little lonely.
